verdict.rationale: Floot's own platform documents scheduled jobs that run without a server to keep alive. That is a recurring-schedule capability that runs in the background of apps built on Floot, but the evidence is a single line with no detail on how users configure, trigger, or monitor these automations. missing for 10: documentation of setting up and configuring scheduled jobs, event-driven or trigger-based automations, monitoring and logs for background runs, agent-driven autonomous workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Jobs that run on a schedule, without a server to keep alive.
